items.raw_excerpt: Guntur neurosurgeon Dr. Mohana Rao Patibandla discusses minimally invasive techniques for accessing deep brain lesions while preserving healthy tissue.
items.summary_en: A brain surgeon in Guntur talks about less invasive surgery. He explains ways to reach deep brain problems while saving healthy tissue. The method aims to protect the brain.
items.summary_ko: 구투르의 신경외과 의사가 덜 침습적인 수술법을 이야기합니다. 건강한 조직을 보존하면서 뇌 깊은 부위의 병변에 접근하는 방법을 설명합니다. 이 수술법은 뇌를 보호하는 데 목적을 둡니다.
items.title_en: Doctor explains gentle brain surgery method
items.title_ko: 구투르 신경외과 의사, 덜 침습적인 뇌수술 소개
items.title_original: Guntur neurosurgeon highlights minimally invasive brain surgery

items.raw_excerpt: Amid a week of heavy debate about borrowing 400 billion baht, questions about the legitimacy of the Senate and vows to restore tourism numbers to pre-Covid levels, an admittedly trivial exercise initiated by Thai officials ended up speaking volumes.
items.summary_en: Thai officials started a small translation exercise during a week of big political debates. The debate covered borrowing 400 billion baht, questions about the Senate, and plans to restore tourism. The simple translation task ended up saying more than expected about the government's focus.
items.summary_ko: 태국 관리들이 막대한 차입 논의와 상원 합법성, 관광 회복 약속이 오가는 시기에 작은 번역 과제를 시작했다. 단순해 보이던 이 번역 작업은 정부의 관심사에 대해 예상보다 훨씬 많은 것을 말해주게 되었다.

items.raw_excerpt: Kit Bottomley says he discovered he had got the slot on the same day he received his GCSE results.
items.summary_en: Kit Bottomley, 16, will open for the band The Libertines. He found out he got the slot on the same day he received his GCSE results. It is his first big gig.
items.summary_ko: 16세 킷 바텀리가 밴드 더 리버틴스의 오프닝 무대에 서게 됐다. 그는 중등교육자격시험 성적표를 받은 날에 이 소식을 전해 들었다. 자신의 첫 번째 큰 공연이다.
items.title_en: 16-year-old lands dream gig opening for The Libertines
items.title_ko: 16세 소년, 더 리버틴스 오프닝 공연 꿈 이뤄
items.title_original: Boy, 16, lands dream gig opening for The Libertines

items.raw_excerpt: The Madeira Forest Police Corps (CPF) has 36 new members, bringing its total force to 100 officers distributed across 25 forest stations in seven zones of the archipelago.
items.summary_en: The Madeira Forest Police Corps has grown to 100 officers after adding 36 new members. The force is spread across 25 stations in seven zones of the archipelago. This reinforcement helps protect Madeira's forests and natural areas.
items.summary_ko: 마데이라 삼림경찰대에 36명의 신규 인원이 합류하여 전체 규모가 100명이 되었다. 이 인력은 군도 7개 권역의 25개 경찰서에 배치되어 삼림 보호 활동을 수행한다.
items.title_en: Madeira Island Adds 36 Officers to Forest Police
items.title_original: Portugal island to reinforce Forest Police reinforcement

items.raw_excerpt: Taiwan is forecast to experience unstable weather next week with a low-pressure system expected to bring precipitation, the Central Weather Administration (CWA) said Saturday.
items.summary_en: Taiwan is forecast to experience unstable weather next week. A low-pressure system is expected to bring precipitation across the region. The Central Weather Administration announced these conditions on Saturday.
items.summary_ko: 대만은 다음 주 불안정한 날씨를 겪을 것으로 예상됩니다. 저기압 시스템의 영향으로 전국에 강수가 예측되며, 중앙기상청이 토요일 발표한 내용입니다.
items.title_en: Taiwan to face unstable weather next week as low-pressure system develops
items.title_ko: 대만, 저기압 영향으로 불안정한 날씨 예고
items.title_original: Taiwan to face unstable weather next week as low-pressure system develops
